metadata.description:
PROBE (retail b150 lifecycle): load → tutorial → ESC-skip → first customer,
truncated after the first BARGAIN round. For RE of the cc08==4 skip→first-
customer b150 modal-hold (rec f461→f1018). NOT a parity scenario.

Full post-tutorial story-cutscene flow → day 2.  Recorded skip path:
load → tutorial → ESC-skip → first customer → cutscenes → day 2 brooming.

Full post-tutorial story-cutscene flow → day 2.  Recorded skip path:
load → tutorial → ESC-skip → first customer → cutscenes → day 2 brooming.

From-NEW_GAME overview spanning the Continue/Load worker load — the speed
benchmark for D1 capture-suppression. Port load-stretch ~1750 frames.
title boots, no input, hold 60 frames — captures cursor pulse + BG scroll

Guild buy menu -> max-qty buy of the Worn Sword -> the row sells out (cap 0)
-> the buy list draws "Out Of Stock". Capture EXTRA_SPRITE_END+480..840 to
compare the sold-out overlay port vs retail.

Merchants-guild buy-flow UI bench (v3 N4 stress): 2600-frame caprange across
several load seams — house exit, world map, guild entry, cutscene, buy menu.

cc08==4 ESC skip: inject ESC + Z during the haggle tutorial → "Cancelling
tutorial. Are you sure?" → Yes → dissolve to free-roam (not the pause menu).

In-shop customer-service / price-haggling tutorial (first-customer selling).
Milestone-1 window: counter approach → Z initiate → first haggle UI.

In-shop customer-service / price-haggling tutorial (first-customer selling).
Milestone-1 window: counter approach → Z initiate → first haggle UI.

Continue/load the fa7c82 save → HOUSE free-roam → walk to the back-stand
swords → action-button opens the display context menu → MANAGE DISPLAY →
remove the top-right sword. {calltrace} over the interaction window so a
--target retail (or both) run drops the cc08 interaction-state timeline.

Continue/load fa7c82 → HOUSE → walk to the back-stand swords → Z opens the
display-stand remove-item menu.  Contiguous {caprange} over the open so the
white-HUD leak, the menu panel render (FUN_0046b00a/FUN_00485f8c), and the
player interact pose/facing can be matched frame-for-frame vs retail.

PINNED variant of house-display-remove: same drive (load fa7c82 → walk to the
back stand → Z opens the cc04==1 remove menu) but with {phasepin}+canonical
{rngseed:19937} so the RNG-driven sparkle + bg-NPCs are bit-aligned port↔retail.

HOUSE free-roam → walk to the shop door → hold.  caprange LOADING_END+140..260
captures the door "go!" tooltip (retail draws it; the port does not yet).
Pinned (phasepin 282 + rngseed [282,19937] + tutloadpin 8) like the guild traces.

Trimmed first-customer-arrival probe (load → tutorial → skip → wrap-up → first
customer → first BARGAIN).  Same pins as house-firstcust-cutscene-day2.

Full post-tutorial story-cutscene flow → day 2.  Recorded skip path:
load → tutorial → ESC-skip → first customer → cutscenes → day 2 brooming.

Full post-tutorial story-cutscene flow → day 2.  Recorded skip path:
load → tutorial → ESC-skip → first customer → cutscenes → day 2 brooming.

HOUSE real free-roam, Recette idle at the bottom, back-window NPC on screen.
README house hero — drive with --show-fps. Sweeps HF#2 +60..+1560 to locate
the NPC-visible cap.

HOUSE real free-roam, Recette idle at the bottom, back-window NPC on screen.
README house hero (docs/img/hero-house-freeroam.png). Sweeps HF#2 +60..+1560
to locate the NPC-visible cap.

Continue/load the fa7c82 save → HOUSE free-roam with 3 swords on the back
stand; capture LOADING_END+120..168 to eyeball the per-item sparkle emitter.

Continue/load the fa7c82 save → HOUSE free-roam with 3 swords on the back
stand; capture LOADING_END+120..168 to eyeball the per-item sparkle emitter.

New game → HOUSE → walk left. Three anchor-relative captures, all keyed to
the 2nd HOUSE_FREEROAM (which lands in the shop tutorial; free-roam is
~1500 frames later once the A-spam clears the dialog — engine-quirks §55):
cap_00 idle free-roam (+1540), cap_01 walking after LEFT (+1640), cap_02
still walking (+1900). The port player is frozen (movement controller
unported) so the walking caps are the intended port(frozen)-vs-retail
(striding) parity baseline until FUN_0048b850 ports.

HOUSE free-roam idle → ESC at +160 → retail opens the pause menu; the port
swallows ESC (unported).  Capture LOADING_END+120..360 to compare port vs
retail.  Pinned (phasepin 80) so the pre-ESC free-roam matches 1:1.

Pause → 1×down to ENCYCLOPEDIA → Z opens the type-6 submenu.  Capture the
PAUSE_READY+0..300 extent; slice the open + resting catalog region for the
port↔retail diff.  Pinned (phasepin 80) so the pre-ESC free-roam matches 1:1.

Pause → Encyclopedia → {wait ENCYCLOPEDIA_READY} → 0x40 examine (detail overlay)
→ 0x40 close.  Pinned (phasepin 80).

Pause → 1×down to ENCYCLOPEDIA → Z opens the type-6 submenu.  Capture the
PAUSE_READY+0..300 extent; slice the open + resting catalog region for the
port↔retail diff.  Pinned (phasepin 80) so the pre-ESC free-roam matches 1:1.

Pause → 1×down to ENCYCLOPEDIA → Z opens the type-6 submenu.  Capture the
PAUSE_READY+0..300 extent; slice the open + resting catalog region for the
port↔retail diff.  Pinned (phasepin 80) so the pre-ESC free-roam matches 1:1.

Pause → 1×down to Encyclopedia → Z; {wait ENCYCLOPEDIA_READY} → page categories
(R/L shoulder), column/edge (Right/Left), rows (Down/Up).  Pinned (phasepin 80).

Pause → 4×down to EXIT GAME → Z opens the exit-confirm dialog → Z confirms.
Capture PAUSE_READY+0..500 to cover the menu nav → dialog → confirm → the
fade/title transition.

Pause → Z opens the type-1 Items submenu (display_menu mode 5).  Capture the
PAUSE_READY+0..300 extent; slice the open + resting inventory grid for the
port↔retail diff.  Pinned (phasepin 80) so the pre-ESC free-roam matches 1:1.

Pause → 2×down to OPTIONS → Z opens the type-2 submenu; then (rebased on
OPTIONS_READY) drive the config-panel nav — cursor down through all 5 rows +
change Sound / Message Speed / Unread Text Skip.  Capture the OPTIONS_READY
+0..300 extent for the port↔retail diff (drive with --anchor OPTIONS_READY).
Pinned (phasepin 80) so the pre-ESC free-roam matches 1:1.

Pause → 3×down to SAVE → Z opens the save submenu.  Capture the PAUSE_OPEN+0..360
extent; slice the nav+submenu region (PAUSE_OPEN+~110..) for the port↔retail diff.
Pinned (phasepin 80) so the pre-ESC free-roam matches 1:1.

Pause → 3×down to SAVE → Z opens the save submenu → A on the occupied home
slot 0 → "Overwriting file?" Yes → the commit animation runs → the picker rests
showing the re-saved slot.  Capture SAVE_PICKER_READY+0..200; slice for the
port↔retail diff of the overwrite dialog + commit anim + progress bar.

Pause → 3×down to SAVE → Z → DOWN onto empty slot 1 → A → the empty-slot direct
commit animation. Capture SAVE_PICKER_READY+0..160; compare the commit anim +
the card NO-DATA→occupied transform vs retail (port#N vs retail#N+1 seam).

Pause → 3×down to SAVE → Z opens the save submenu → DOWN ×5 / UP ×4 scroll the
100-slot list → B closes.  Capture PAUSE_READY+0..360; slice the open+nav region
for the port↔retail diff (the render is already pixel-1:1 per cursor/scroll, so
a matching nav ⇒ pixel-1:1 scrolling).

Walk UP off spawn → ESC (pause) → ESC (unpause) → resume.  Capture
PAUSE_READY+0..140 (open menu over the frozen scene → close ramp → resumed
free-roam); the state panel px/py must stay at the walked-to spot, not spawn.

New game → HOUSE → slide against the central round table; capture 9 frames
(rel 1805–1851) drilling into the table-corner collision divergence. Permanent
regression guard derived from the house-walk-tables full-slide trace.

New game → HOUSE → hold DOWN into the front of the room. cap_00 idle (+1540),
cap_01 after walking down (+2400). Pair with --player-pos-log / --watch +
tools/wall_collide_diff.py for the px/pz/py accuracy diff.
Hold DOWN; capture every frame anchor+1592..1628. Foot-dust depth + phase check.

Hold DOWN in HOUSE free-roam; 5 mid-walk captures. Checks the foot dust draws
behind the walking player (depth/order parity).

New game → HOUSE → hold LEFT into the central table / behind-counter furniture.
cap_00 idle (+1540), cap_01 after walking left (+2100). Pair with
--player-pos-log / --watch + tools/wall_collide_diff.py.

New game → HOUSE → navigate behind the counter (RIGHT, UP) then LEFT into the
central round table. Retail pins head-on at px=0.729 pz=0.107 (w4-table3).
cap_00 idle (+1540), cap_01 against the table (+1760).

New game → HOUSE → thorough collision tour against the HOUSE display tables
(diagonal movement), 22 capture points along the path. User-recorded (F2/F3) +
distilled. Regression bench for the multi-object furniture collision vs retail.

New game → HOUSE → walk RIGHT into the right wall. Two anchor-relative captures
keyed to the 2nd HOUSE_FREEROAM: cap_00 idle free-roam (+1540), cap_01 pressed
against the right wall after holding RIGHT (+1780). Pair with --player-pos-log
(port) / --watch (retail) + tools/wall_collide_diff.py for the px/pz accuracy
diff — the visual caps alone don't show the sub-unit standoff.

New game → opening prologue; one capture per dialogue line at TEXT_ANIM_END
(46 lines). Phase-0 per-line reference images for the opening cutscene/dialogue.
iv1_1 fade-from-black anchored to EXTRA_SPRITE_FADEOUT — 5 frames.

iv1_2 conversation pose synced at the anim-6 frame-1 blink (CONV_POSE_BLINK, a
unique once-per-cycle eyes-closed marker) after the iv1_2 load (HF#2) — both
montages land on the SAME blink, zoomed onto Recette's freeroam sprite. Spans
+0..+44 (the frame-1 blink, the d32 open hold, the frame-3 blink at +38).

iv1_2 opening (post-fade, during char slide-in) — Recette look-up + blink,
zoomed onto her sprite; dense reference for diffing vs retail.

iv1_2 overlay conversation (covers=false, HOUSE scene behind) v3 draw-program
window at HF#2 for prologue drawcall parity vs retail.
iv1_1 opening: fade-from-black (kuro) + Tear slide-in, 8 frames pre-line-1.

Settle on the iv1_2 "Patience, Recette" line (Tear); capture the speaker
nameplate fading in (TEXT_ANIM_END +2/+30/+60/+120/+240).

New game → opening prologue (Recette/Tear), call-trace over the prologue
segment (1st HOUSE_FREEROAM + 1600 frames). Phase-0 ground-truth for the
opening cutscene/dialogue subsystem.

New game -> opening prologue cutscene start (1st HOUSE_FREEROAM). v3 window
over the first iv1_1 dialogue line for drawcall + flow-trace parity vs retail.

iv1_1 sigh effect sprite (chr:6) framed by EXTRA_SPRITE_START — 3 fade-in +
3 fade-out frames; verifies extra-sprite fade renders 1:1 vs retail.

ESC skip Yes/No choice box over a settled line, armed via the {esc} TAS op +
{phasepin} (cursor bob phase-1:1). cap_00 Yes / cap_01 No.
DOWN press at frame 30 — cursor steps NEW GAME → MINIGAME
Title → DOWN×1 → A → all-banks encyclopedia slides in (FUN_0049f8b8 render)
Title → DOWN×1 → A → all-banks 図鑑, MAXED save (populated grid 1:1)

Title → A (LOAD GAME) → continue/load slot picker; capture the slide-in +
steady picker grid for render parity vs retail.
Title → DOWN×2 → A → settings panel slides in (FUN_0049c050 render)

Title → A (open LOAD GAME picker) → B (back out) → DOWN. The post-cancel
DOWN must move the main-menu cursor; proves the back-out re-opens input.
Title → DOWN×2 → A → Records screen (crafted records, populated 1:1)
Title → UP → A → Survival difficulty selector (Hell/Normal, 1:1)
Z (button A) press at frame 30 → select countdown → dispatch at 44 → fade-OUT, then placeholder INGAME fades in

customer_service.description: Customer transaction, haggling, and counter service interactions

accept_offer.semantic_intent: Accept customer offer at current proposed price

reject_offer.semantic_intent: Reject transaction or refuse to sell item

house_pause.description: In-house pause menu and save picker interactions

open_pause.semantic_intent: Press ESC to open in-game pause menu

navigate_to_save.semantic_intent: Navigate down 3 times to Save option

commit_save_slot.semantic_intent: Confirm overwrite and commit save to selected slot

title_menu.description: Title screen menu navigation and option selection

navigate_down.semantic_intent: Move title menu cursor down by one slot

navigate_up.semantic_intent: Move title menu cursor up by one slot

dismiss_submenu.semantic_intent: Back out of active title submenu
